title: Merge k Sorted Lists
statement_short: Given an array of k linked lists, where each list is sorted in ascending order, merge all the linked lists into one sorted linked list and return it.
hint: Total node count up to 10^4 allows extracting minimum heads efficiently using a min-heap structure.
why_not: Right: Heap / Priority Queue maintains a min-heap of active list heads to continuously extract the smallest element in O(N log k) time. Not Two Pointers: Two pointers merge two lists, but comparing k lists linearly takes O(N \* k) time. Not Sorting: Dumping all node values into an array and sorting costs O(N log N) time and extra memory. Not 1D DP: Subproblem state memoization does not apply to multi-pointer node traversal.
complexity: O(N log k) time, O(k) space
